name: Pharmacology
description: Pharmacokinetics (ADME), pharmacodynamics, autonomic pharmacology, antimicrobials, and cardiovascular drugs.

topics.name: Pharmacokinetics (ADME)
topics.description: Absorption, bioavailability, volume of distribution, clearance

questions.prompt: What pharmacokinetic parameter indicates the fraction of an administered drug dose that reaches systemic circulation in active form?
questions.explanation: Bioavailability (F) is the fraction of unchanged drug that reaches the systemic circulation (100% for IV administration).

questions.prompt: What is the primary mechanism of action of beta-lactam antibiotics like penicillin?
options: Inhibition of bacterial cell wall peptidoglycan synthesis via transpeptidase binding
questions.explanation: Beta-lactams bind penicillin-binding proteins (transpeptidases), blocking cross-linking of the peptidoglycan cell wall.
